source: Polly... I've been meaning to ask you... how... how do you road trip?
target: 波莉... 我一直想问你... 怎么会... 路途怎么样?

source: There's no shame in asking, Scott! Let me explain.
target: 没什么可羞耻的 斯科特! 让我解释一下。

source: All of us will SHARE six essential RESOURCES... and we need to manage them wisely to keep this trip afloat!
target: 我们所有人都会分享六种重要资源... 我们要明智地管理他们 才能让这次旅行顺利进行!

source: So we need to be careful, 'cause the choices we make during the trip can affect these RESOURCES!
target: 所以我们要小心,因为我们在旅途中作出的选择会影响这些资源!

source: And if one of them depletes completely... we can kiss this road trip goodbye.
target: 如果其中之一完全耗尽... 我们可以亲吻这个路途再见。

source: I get it! So our goal is to avoid running out of any RESOURCE and keep road-tripping forever!
target: 我懂了! 说吧! I get it! 因此,我们的目标是避免耗尽任何资源 并永远保持道路拖拉!

source: No, no: the goal is to reach one of the six DESTINATIONS every road trip leads to.
target: 不,不:目标是在每次出行前达到六个DESTINATIONS中的一个。

source: I have this travel guide that explains how each DESTINATION requires us to hoard a different RESOURCE.
target: 我有一个旅行指南 来解释为什么每个节奏需要我们 囤积不同的资源。

source: (You can check said guide whenever you want.)
target: (您可以随时检查指针)

source: (Touch the DESTINATION tab to the right or press the button shown in the tab.)
target: (按下鼠标标签右侧或按下标签中显示的按钮。)

source: (Press the button shown in the DESTINATION tab.)
target: (按下DESTINTION标签中显示的按钮. )

source: (Press the button shown in the DESTINATION tab.)
target: (按下DESTINTION标签中显示的按钮. )

source: (Click on the DESTINATION tab to the right, or press E on the keyboard or LB on the controller.)
target: (点击右侧的DESTINTION标签,或按键盘上E键或控制器上LB键.

source: (There, you'll find the REQUIREMENTS to reach a DESTINATION and WIN THE GAME.)
target: (在那里,你会找到 需要达到 DESTINGATION和WIN The GAME。)

source: Enough exposition, narrator voice inside our heads!
target: 说够了 旁白在我们脑中的声音!

source: We get it: keep our RESOURCES far above zero and hoard enough of one RESOURCE to reach a DESTINATION.
target: 我们得到的是: 保持我们的资源远远高于零, 并囤积足够一个资源 达到一个DESTING。

source: Let's go!
target: 我们走!

source: Woohoo, again! Let's choose an ACTION and make an EVENT happen!
target: 呜呼,又来了! 让我们选择行动 并让一个事件发生!

source: Yes! I'm ready for all the randomness these EVENTS involve.
target: 没错! 我准备好面对这些事件所涉及的所有随机性了

source: Actually, Polly, I was checking this travel guide, and it seems they aren't so random after all...
target: 其实 波莉我在检查这个旅行指南, 似乎他们不是那么随机的毕竟...

source: Look, these different SIGNS apparently refer to different types of EVENTS!
target: 你看,这些不同的SIGNS显然是指不同类型的EvenTS!

source: The most common type of EVENTS are called EXCHANGE EVENTS.
target: 最常见的类型的EvenTS被称为EXCHANGE EvenTS.

source: After making a choice in those, you'll always lose a RESOURCE and gain a RESOURCE no matter what.
target: 在做出选择后,无论怎样,你都会失去资源并获得资源.

source: The trick is making the right CHOICE, since that'll decide which RESOURCES are gained and lost.
target: 诀窍是使正确的CHOICE, 因为那会决定哪些资源是获得的和损失的。

source: But if there's a RESOURCE SIGN next to the EVENT TYPE SIGN, that's called a "KNOWN RESOURCE".
target: 但是,如果在Event Type Sign旁边有一个资源信号,那就叫做"KNOWN 资源".

source: It means that RESOURCE is guaranteed to be affected no matter what our CHOICE is.
target: 这意味着,无论我们崔克是什么,资源都保证会受到影响。

source: If the SIGN is POSITIVE, then the RESOURCE is guaranteed to be gained. If it's NEGATIVE, then you know you'll lose it.
target: 如果SIGN是积极性的,那么保证获得资源. 如果是恩吉亚特,那你知道你会失去它。

source: Like, for example... if we see an ACTION with this sign, we know we'll lose MONEY here. Our CHOICE will only determine which RESOURCE we'll GAIN.
target: 比如说... 如果我们看到这个标志的动作, 我们知道我们会失去钱在这里。 我们的选手只能决定我们用什么资源

source: That's not so bad! If we know losing or gaining a RESOURCE is unavoidable, we could be strategic about it!
target: 这还不算太糟! 如果我们知道失去或获得资源是不可避免的, 我们可以对此有战略意义!

source: This all sounds very useful... but also like too much pressure for fan-favorite Polly to keep track of.
target: 这听起来非常有用... 也喜欢太多的压力 粉丝喜欢 波莉 保持追踪。

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, can we leave these decisions to you? Thaaanks.
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%我们能把这些决定留给你吗? 塔安克丝。

source: Whoa, I'm getting dizzy watching our resources go up and down!
target: 哇,我快晕倒了 看着我们的资源上下!

source: Yeah, man. Is it even possible to know what we're losing or gaining BEFOREHAND?!
target: 是啊,伙计。 甚至有可能知道我们在失去什么 或获得之前?

source: Dang, we're doomed. Put something on the radio. We may fuck up this road trip, but at least we'll fuck it up while having some fun...
target: 妈的,我们死定了。 把东西在收音机上。 我们可能会搞砸这次出行 但至少我们会在玩乐时搞砸...

source: Okay!
target: 好,我们走!

source: "Welcome to our humble radio show, where our guests give narratively-convenient road trip tips."
target: "欢迎来到我们谦卑的电台节目, 我们的来宾们在节目中 给讲故事的方便的公路旅行提示。"

source: "Today, we have road trip survivors Cormac S. Thompson and Hunter McCarthy. Guys, what can you share with our audience?"
target: "今天,我们有公路旅行幸存者 Cormac S. 汤普森和亨特麦卡锡 各位,你们能和我们的观众分享什么?”

source: Let me start by saying that the number one cause of road trip-related deaths is not properly understanding how to manage RESOURCES.
target: 首先,我要说,与道路旅行有关的死亡的首要原因,是没有正确理解如何管理资源。

source: Ah, yes, the dreaded six. Most unexperienced road-trippers think they behave in arbitrary ways, but that's simply not true.
target: 啊,是的,可怕的六个。 大部分没有经验的路人认为他们的行为方式是任意的,但这完全不是事实.

source: When you're making choices on the road, you have to look for little cues to infer what RESOURCE you'll be losing or gaining.
target: 当你在路上做出选择时,你必须寻找一些小提示来推断你将会失去或获得什么资源。

source: MONEY might be the easiest one: are you buying or renting something? MONEY down. Hiring someone? MONEY down. Doing a job or selling something? MONEY up.
target: 你买还是租? 钱倒了。 雇人吗? 钱倒了。 干活还是卖东西? 钱了。

source: But beware! Sometimes a solution doesn't obviously involve buying something, but it involves using expensive stuff you may need to rent or buy!
target: 但当心! 有时候,一个解决方案显然不涉及购买什么,但它涉及使用贵重的东西你可能需要租去或买去!

source: And what about MAGIC? The mysterious substance that fuels our cars...
target: MAGIC怎么办? 神秘的物质 燃料我们的汽车...

source: MAGIC is tricky because sometimes you'll need to use it for spells, summonings, and curses... but that will mean lowering your MAGIC and risking an empty fuel tank.
target: MAGIC很狡猾,因为有时你需要用它来作咒语,召唤和诅咒...... 但是,这意味着降低你的MAGIC 并冒险 一个空的燃料箱。

source: And getting MAGIC up can be quite hard. You could find a gas station, or you may need to resort to performing sacrifices or colluding with strange, powerful entities...
target: 让MAGIC起来可能很困难。 你可以找到一个加油站, 或者你可能需要利用 进行牺牲 或与奇怪的,强大的实体串通...

source: Y'know, classic road trip stuff!
target: 你知道,经典的公路旅行的东西!

source: "Our time is up, fellas! Let's discuss the other RESOURCES in future episodes of everyone's favorite radio show: 'CONVENIENT EXPOSITION!'"
target: "我们的时间到了,伙计们! 让我们在未来的节目中 讨论另一个资源 每个人最喜欢的广播节目: 'CONVENT EXPOSITION!"

source: *applause*
target: * 赞美 *

source: Whoa, that was stupidly convenient! Scott, did you take notes?
target: 哇,这太方便了!  斯科特你做笔记了吗?

source: Nope.
target: 没有。

source: Well, I hope %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% did, at least. Otherwise, we're truly fucked... and not in the good way.
target: 好吧,我希望%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%至少做到了。 否则,我们真的完蛋了... 而不是在好的方式。

source: Hey, Polly! Look what time it is!
target: 顿 波莉! 看看现在几点了!

source: Oh, fuck yeah! Put the radio on, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!
target: 哦,他妈的是的! 打开收音机 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!

source: "Welcome back to 'CONVENIENT EXPOSITION', the radio show where our guests give narratively-convenient road trip tips!"
target: "欢迎回到"CONVENT EXPOSITION",电台节目,我们的来宾们在节目中以叙事般的方便方式给出出行提示"!

source: "Mr. Thompson, Mr. McCarthy: what can you tell us about the mysterious RESOURCE known as... STAMINA?"
target: "先生说:"...... 汤普森先生 麦卡锡:关于神秘的资源被称为... 斯塔米娜吗?

source: Ah, STAMINA... the fuel for our bodies... yum!
target: 啊,斯塔米纳... 我们身体的燃料... 是啊!

source: Getting STAMINA up is simple: EAT STUFF! STAY HYDRATED! GET SOME REST!
target: 让斯塔米纳起来很简单 吃东西! 保持九头蛇状态! 获取一些休息!

source: This is important, since arduous activities such as exercising or having intercourse will eat up your STAMINA.
target: 这一点很重要,因为锻炼或性交等艰苦活动会吞噬你的STAMINA。

source: Throwing your food away or using it in ways that don't involve eating it will also lower your STAMINA.
target: 把你的食物扔掉或者用在 不吃的东西上 也会降低你的STAMINA。

source: Cormac, something you said about STAMINA reminded me of MIND...
target: Cormac,你说的STAMINA让我想起了MIND...

source: It takes an experienced road-tripper to differentiate how resting raises your STAMINA, but relaxing raises your MIND.
target: 要区分休息如何提升你的STAMINA, 放松提升你的心智。

source: You're spot-on, Hunter. A strong, relaxed MIND can save you from succumbing to road madness and what to this day I suspect is an ancient deity preying on mortals' psyches.
target: 你是现场,猎人。 一个强大,放松的MIND可以让你免于 屈服于疯狂的道路, 而今天我怀疑的是一个古老的神 猎取凡人的精神。

source: Relaxing and finding enlightenment will keep your MIND up, and so will strengthening your brain by learning new things!
target: 放松和寻找启蒙 将保持你的思维, 通过学习新事物加强你的大脑!

source: But if you overtax your brain, you may actually risk lowering your MIND.
target: 但是如果你的大脑课税过重, 你可能会冒风险降低你的心智。

source: Anything that strains your brain can result in MIND loss, from trying to comprehend the incomprehensible to getting in anxiety-inducing situations!
target: 从试图理解无法理解的事物到陷入令人焦虑的境地 任何让你的大脑紧张的事物都会导致MIND的损失!

source: "You betcha!" Says the radio host, "Even thinking a lot for too long... like myself after this very edifying rumination... which is why we'll stop this episode right here!"
target: "You betcha!"电台主持人说:"即使想了很多,也太久了...... 像我一样,在这场非常激起反响之后... 这就是为什么我们在这里停止这个剧集!"

source: "Cormac S. Thompson and Hunter McCarthy, everyone!"
target: "Cormac S. 汤普森和亨特麦卡锡,大家好!"

source: (applause)
target: (掌声)

source: Thompson and McCarthy, amirite?
target: 汤普森和麦卡锡?

source: No... I have no idea what you mean by that, Scott.
target: 没有... 我不知道你在说什么 斯科特.

source: Me neither, Polly... me neither.
target: 我也一样 波莉... 我也一样。

source: Scott, fuck! Turn the radio on; "CONVENIENT EXPOSITION" has started already! We can't miss it!
target: 斯科特他妈的! 打开收音机 "CONVENT ExPOSITION"已经开始了! 我们不能错过!

source: Roger!
target: 罗杰!

source: "Mr. Thompson, what were you telling us about HYPE, again?"
target: "先生说:"...... 汤普森,你告诉我们什么 关于HYPE,再次?"

source: Yes, let me repeat: anything that makes you rejoice to your core will get your HYPE up.
target: 是的,让我重复一遍:任何让你对核心感到快乐的事物,都会使你的HYPE站起.

source: That includes laughing out loud, doing thrill-seeking stuff, or going to town, if you know what I mean... wink!
target: 包括大叫大笑, 做刺激的东西, 或者去镇上, 如果你明白我的意思... 眨眼点!

source: I like keeping my HYPE strong and vigorous. That's why I avoid all the stuff that will lower my HYPE...
target: 我喜欢保持我的HYPE强而有力。 这就是为什么我避开所有会降低我的HYPE的东西...

source: Like doing boring stuff, mingling with dull or annoying people, or choosing mundane solutions over epic ones.
target: 比如做无聊的事情, 和无聊或烦人的人混在一起, 或者选择平庸的解决方案 而不是史诗般的解决方案。

source: Amen!
target: 阿门!

source: Speaking of boring stuff, you know what else is boring? Being a good person!
target: 说到无聊的东西 你知道还有什么是无聊的吗? 做个好人

source: But sometimes you need to be if you want to keep your SOUL up.
target: 但有时你需要 如果你想要保持你的SOUL起来。

source: Ugh, yeah. Why do we need to have SOULS anyway?!
target: 呃,对。 我们为什么非得有SOULS?

source: Beats me.
target: 难怪我

source: At least SOUL is quite easy to manage: doing good deeds? SOUL up. Being your worst self? SOUL down.
target: 至少SOUL很容易管理:做好事? 安静。 成为你最糟糕的自己吗? 安静下来。

source: So remember, kids: don't underestimate the power of helping strangers while you're on the road. You gotta keep your SOUL healthy and clean.
target: 记住,孩子们:不要低估在路上帮助陌生人的能力。 你得保持你的SOUL健康和干净。

source: "Amazing, simply amazing. Your tips have been extremely helpful and incredibly expositive. You've provided a great tutorial for anyone who aims to have a successful road trip."
target: "惊人,简直令人惊叹" 你的提示非常有帮助 并且非常积极 你为任何想要成功出行的人提供了很好的辅导".

source: "Cormac S. Thompson and Hunter McCarthy, everyone!"
target: "Cormac S. 汤普森和亨特麦卡锡,大家好!"

source: *applause*
target: * 赞美 *

source: Whoa, Polly... I think I've grown as a person.
target: 哗! 波莉... 我想我已经成长为一个人。

source: Yeah, Cormac S. Thompson and Hunter McCarthy are part of the family from now on.
target: 是的,克马克S。 汤普森和亨特·麦卡锡从此成为了家族的一员.

source: A toast to CONVENIENT EXPOSITION!
target: 干杯 敬Convention Exposition! 干杯! 干杯! 干杯!

source: Hooray!
target: 万岁!

source: Ugh, finally, a place to rest... even this spectral booty needs to do some sitting after so much shaking.
target: 终于有地方休息了... 即使是这个光谱战利品 也需要在摇晃后坐着

source: The guide says there are several REST STOPS like this one! We should be able to reach one, like, once a week, after visiting four LOCATIONS or so.
target: 导游说,有好几个 REST停止像这样的! 我们应该能够达到一个,比如说,每周一次,在访问四个地点之后。

source: That sounds good. Let's go chill on those benches, Scott.
target: 听起来不错。 让我们去冷却 在那些长椅上, 斯科特.

source: As your friends leave, you realize you don't want to rest, because you're utterly addicted to making choices all the time.
target: 当你的朋友离开的时候,你意识到你不想休息, 因为你完全沉迷于做出所有的选择。

source: And this REST STOP is no different...
target: 和这个休息停止 没有什么不同...

source: You quickly assess the many (well, five) things you can check out around here...
target: 你很快地评估了这里可以查查的很多(好,五)件事情......

source: But beware: with the exception of THE CAR, each choice can only accommodate ONE PLAYER. It's first come first serve!
target: 但当心:除了"CAR"之外,每个选择只能容纳"一玩"(One Player). 先来先来!

source: Now, go and see what the different spots do!
target: 现在,去看看 不同的斑点做什么!

source: Welcome to THE BENCHES, where you can relax and talk with either Polly or Scott.
target: 欢迎光临BENCHES, 在那里你可以放松和交谈 无论是与 波莉 或者说 斯科特.

source: The CONVERSATIONS you can hold with them are a chill narrative treat with no choices to be made.
target: 你可以和他们交谈 是一种冷酷的叙事 没有任何选择

source: If you have enough CONVERSATIONS, you might score a DATE ENDING with one of them!
target: 如果你有足够的对话, 你可能会得到一个约会结束 与其中之一!

source: Also, by having a CONVERSATION with Polly or Scott, you'll activate the "Chaotic Energy" PASSIVE EFFECT, which will remain active for the following WEEK.
target: 此外,通过与下列机构进行对话, 波莉 或者说 斯科特,你将激活"Chatic Energy" PASSIVE EFFECT, 它将在接下来的WEEK中保持活性.

source: What does it do, exactly? Find out for yourself!
target: 它到底做什么的? 到底有什么用吗? 你自己去查个清楚!

source: Now go make some small talk!
target: 现在去谈点小事!

source: This is THE BUS STOP.
target: 这是BUS停止。

source: You can either check for HITCHHIKERS to pick up, or have a CONVERSATION with the one that's already riding with you.
target: 你可以去查查HITCHIKERS去接 或者跟那个已经跟你搭车的人谈谈

source: CONVERSATIONS are a chill, narrative treat with no choices to be made.
target: 谈话是一种冷漠的叙事方式,没有选择余地。

source: If you hold enough CONVERSATIONS with the same hitchhiker, you might score a DATE ENDING!
target: 如果你和同一个搭便车的人 有足够的交谈,你可能会得到一个约会结束!

source: Additionally, each time someone interacts with a HITCHHIKER, their PASSIVE EFFECT is triggered.
target: 此外,每当有人与HITCHIKER互动时,他们的PASVE效应就会被触发.

source: As you play, you'll learn what each character's PASSIVE EFFECT does. Exciting!
target: 当你演奏时,你会学会每个角色的PASIVE EFFECT做什么. 令人兴奋!

source: You can only have one HITCHHIKER at a time. If you pick up a new one, any prior HITCHHIKER will leave into the dark of the night!
target: 你每次只能吃一粒HITCHIKER. 如果你拿起一个新的, 任何之前HITCHIKER会离开 进入黑暗的夜晚!

source: Welcome to the BARTERING STAND, where you can barter with little trinkets and manage your RESOURCES a bit.
target: 欢迎来到BARTERING StAND, 你可以在那里用小金币来交换 并管理你的资源一点点。

source: Each TRINKET is tied to a RESOURCE.
target: 每个TRINKET都与资源挂钩.

source: You'll lose the RESOURCE tied to the TRINKET you give away and gain the RESOURCE tied to the trinket you take.
target: 你会失去与TRINKET挂钩的资源... ... 并获得与你拿的三分钱挂钩的资源。

source: (Also, Noodles is here, but I dunno if that's a good thing...)
target: (还有,面条在这里, 但我不知道,如果这是好事... )

source: This is the MAP INFO BOARD, where you can do TWO things:
target: 这是MAP InFO董事会 你可以在这里做两件事:

source: You can check a MAP that shows THREE potential LOCATIONS nearby.
target: 您可以检查一个显示 THREE 潜在位置的 MAP 。

source: Choose a LOCATION to learn how to get there. This guarantees that that LOCATION will appear on your next TURN.
target: 选择一个位置来学习如何到达那里。 这保证了你的下场会出现位置。

source: On the other hand, you can use the PHONE to call HITCHHIKERS.
target: 另一方面,你可以使用电话给HITCHIKERS打电话.

source: When you visit the BUS STOP next week, the HITCHHIKER you called will be there!
target: 下星期你去看BUS停赛时 你打电话的HITCHIKER会在那里!

source: These TWO options are all about taking an extra step to secure an outcome you want (be it a LOCATION or a HITCHHIKER)!
target: 这两个选择都是为了采取额外步骤来取得你想要的结果(无论是定位还是HITCHIKER)!

source: THE CAR is where you can manage your road trip by accessing one of two mini-boosts.
target: 通过进入两个迷你车手之一 你就可以管理你的出行

source: You can choose to be a CAREFUL PLANNER and gain +1 of your LOWEST RESOURCE and lose -1 of your HIGHEST RESOURCE.
target: 你可以选择成为一个小心翼翼的工程师 并获得你最低的资源+1 并失去你的最高的资源。

source: Or you can be a RISKY TRAVELLER and gain +1 of your HIGHEST RESOURCE at the cost of -1 of your LOWEST RESOURCE. Dangerous!
target: 或者你可以做一个危险的旅行者 以你最低的1个资源 换取你最高的1个资源 危险!

source: So... what's it gonna be, champ?
target: 所以说... 怎么样,冠军?

source: Hey! Wait a sec... that EVENT TYPE sign looks new.
target: 嘿 单... 那个事件TYPE的标志看起来是新的。
notes: Argos en_zh 1.9; requires review; sanitized; sanitized

source: Yeah... according to the travel guide, that sign means this is a "QUANTITIES EVENT".
target: 对... 根据旅行指南,这个标志意味着这是一个"QUANTITIES EVERT".

source: They work a lot like "EXCHANGE EVENTS": we always lose and gain equal amounts of RESOURCES, and we have to guess which RESOURCES are tied to each OPTION.
target: 他们的工作就像“变换事件”一样:我们总是损失和获得同等数量的资源,我们必须猜出哪些资源与每个选项有关。

source: The main difference is the amount of RESOURCES that are affected by each OPTION differ:
target: 主要的区别是受每个选择方案影响的资源数量不同:

source: They can be affected "A BIT", "SOME", or "A FUCKIN' LOT".
target: 他们可能会受到"A BIT","SOME",或者"A fuckIN' LOT"的影响.

source: Scott! You never swear!
target: 斯科特! 你从不发誓!

source: That's how the travel guide phrased it!
target: 旅行指南就是这么说的!

source: Dang! So what this FOUL-MOUTHED travel guide basically says is that we can choose to play it safe or go bonkers...
target: 该死! 所以,这个FOUL -MUTHED 旅行指南 基本上说,我们可以选择 玩安全,或者去疯狂...

source: ...you already know what Momma would choose, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.
target: ...你知道妈妈会选择什么 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.

source: But this one is up to you, boo. Go for it!
target: 但这一个由你决定,嘘。 冲啊!

source: After some CONVERSATIONS, you'll activate a DEEP CONVERSATION. This is your first one!
target: 经过一些交谈,你会启动一个深交会。 这是你的第一个!

source: DEEP CONVERSATIONS can end in SUCCESS or FAILURE, and they're the key to scoring a DATE ENDING.
target: 深交会可以以SUCCESS或FAILURE来结束,它们是给一个"约会"(Date ending)评分的关键.

source: HITCHHIKERS have only one coveted DEEP CONVERSATION each, while Polly and Scott have two!
target: HITCHHIKERS只有一个 渴望深呼吸的谈话,而 波莉 财务报告和审定财务报表 斯科特 来两杯!

source: So, once a player succeeds in a DEEP CONVERSATION (and sometimes even if they fail it), no other player can attempt it.
target: 因此,一旦一个玩家在DEEP Conversation中成功(有时甚至失败),就没有任何其他玩家可以尝试.

source: Act fast, because whoever gets there first will be the only one with a chance at finding love!
target: 动作快,因为谁先到那里 是唯一有机会找到爱的人!

source: How do these work, though?
target: 这些东西怎么用的?

source: During the first half of a DEEP CONVERSATION, your monster friend will hint at their preferences on a topic that's important to them.
target: 在DEEP谈话的前半段,你的怪物朋友会暗示他们对一个对他们很重要的主题的偏好.

source: Think of these hints as "RULES".
target: 把这些暗示当作"RULES".

source: When looking at the options search for ways in which they break the "RULES". Two out of the three will break the "RULES" somehow.
target: 在看选项时,寻找它们打破"RULES"的方法. 三个中有两个会以某种方式打破"RULES".

source: The one that breaks no "RULES" is the RIGHT OPTION. Choose that one and show your friend you really know and understand them.
target: 打破没有"RULES"的就是"权利选择". 选择那个 告诉你的朋友 你真正了解和理解他们。

source: So... are you a good listener or not?
target: 所以说... 你听不懂吗?

source: Congratz! You've reached a DESTINATION!
target: 康格拉兹! 你已经到了一个DESTINTION!

source: But there's more to it: every player gets an INDIVIDUAL ENDING.
target: 但还有更多内容:每个玩家都会得到一个IDIVID个人结束.

source: You could end up being "A LAME LOSER", "JUST OK", or "THE MVP"!
target: 你可能最终是"LAME LOSER","Just OK",或者"The MVP"!

source: In multiplayer mode, the result will be determined based on how much you each contributed to the RESOURCE needed to reach the DESTINATION.
target: 在多人模式下,结果将根据你们各自为达到DESTING所需的RESURCE贡献了多少来决定.

source: In single player mode, it's determined by your overall RESOURCE spread.
target: 在单玩家模式下,它由你的总体RESourCE扩展决定.

source: There's also the DATE ENDING, which has its own requirements...
target: 还有DATE ENDING,它有自己的要求......

source: ...but ending up a LAME LOSER will override the DATE ENDING. No dates allowed for lame losers!
target: ...但最后LAME LOSER 会超过 日期结束。 不准那些烂人约会!

source: Anyway! Let's judge you!
target: 无论如何! 让我们来评判你!

source: Okay, weird idea, but what if we... CREATE A DUMB CURRENCY OF OUR OWN?
target: 好吧,奇怪的想法, 但如果我们... 创造出我们自己的蠢货?

source: Ooh, can we give it a cool name like... "Prank Dollarz"?
target: 哦,我们能给它一个很酷的名字像... 恶作剧"美元"?

source: You betcha!
target: 当然了!

source: And we could encourage our friends to be as fun and random as we are by giving them "PRANK DARES"... that'll pay out "PRANK DOLLARZ" when they're fulfilled!
target: 我们可以鼓励我们的朋友 和我们一样的乐趣和随机 通过给他们"PRANK DARES"... 等他们完成后 就会付"PRANK DOLLARZ"

source: "PRANK DOLLARZ!" HOORAY!
target: "Prank Dollarz!" 万岁! 万岁!

source: Can you buy snacks with PRANK DOLLARZ?
target: 你能用PRANK DOLLARZ买点心吗?

source: Absolutely not!
target: 绝对不行!

source: But we can count them up at the end of the road trip to decide who's been the MVP of the trip, and who's a lame loser.
target: 但是,我们可以在公路旅行结束时算起他们来决定谁是这次旅行的MVP,谁是跛脚的失败者.

source: Sounds fun!
target: 听起来很有趣!

source: And cutthroat competitive!
target: 和切喉比赛!

source: (You can check the current PRANK DARES by touching the player tabs or pressing the button shown in the tabs...)
target: (您可以通过触摸玩家标签或按下标签中显示的按钮来检查当前 PRANK DARES...)

source: (You can check the current PRANK DARES by pressing the button shown in the tabs...)
target: (您可以按下标签中显示的按钮来检查当前 PRANK DARES...)

source: (You can check the current PRANK DARES by pressing the button shown in the tabs...)
target: (您可以按下标签中显示的按钮来检查当前 PRANK DARES...)

source: (You can check the overall PRANK DOLLARZ count by hovering the mouse over the player tabs to the right, or by holding Q in the keyboard or RT in the controller.)
target: (您可以通过将鼠标在玩家的标签上向右盘旋来检查PRANK DOLLARZ的整体计数,也可以通过在键盘上或控制器上将Q保持为RT. ).

source: (...and then moving through them with the right stick to see each player's PRANK DARES.)
target: (...... 然后用右手棍穿过他们,看到每个玩家的PRANK DARES.

source: (And you can check the current PRANK DARES by clicking on the player tabs, or by pressing 1-4 on the keyboard...)
target: (也可以通过点击玩家标签来检查当前PRANK DARES,也可以通过按键盘上1-4. )

source: (You can also check the overall PRANK DOLLARZ count on the same tabs.)
target: (也可以检查PRANK DOLLARZ在同一个分页上计算的总体情况. )

source: (...or RB on the controller, and then moving through them with the right stick.)
target: (... 或RB在控制器上, 然后用右棍穿过它们。 )

source: PRANK DOLLARZ!
target: 普兰克多拉兹!

source: WITH A Z!
target: 与一个Z!

source: Welcome back to the REST STOP!
target: 欢迎回到后退站!

source: You're playing PRANK MASTER MODE; therefore, choosing a REST STOP SPOT has become quite a bit more cutthroat!
target: 你正在玩PRANK MASTER MODE。 因此,选择一个 REST Stop SPOT 已经变得相当可爱了!

source: You can kick other players out of a selected spot by bidding PRANK DOLLARZ, but they can kick you out later by bidding higher!
target: 你可以通过招标PRANK DOLLARZ来将其他球员踢出一个选定的位置,但他们可以稍后通过高价竞标来踢出你!

source: THE CAR is the only option you don't need to bid PRANK DOLLARZ to visit, and it can host as many players as you want!
target: The CAR是您唯一不需要让PRANK DOLLARZ访问的选项,它可以任意容纳尽可能多的玩家!

source: Also, in this mode, everyone who visits THE CAR will earn PRANK DOLLARZ! Whoever goes there first gets the most PRANK DOLLARZ!
target: 而且,在这个模式下,所有访问CAR的人都会赚到PRANK DOLLARZ! 谁先去那里 得到最PRANK DOLLARZ!

source: Finally, don't forget that at the end of every REST STOP, your PRANK DARES will resolve, and each player will get new ones!
target: 最后,不要忘记,在每停一次后,你的PRANK DARES会解决的,每个玩家都会得到新的!

source: Now, go outbid your peers and ruin some friendships!
target: 现在,去比你们的同伴 破坏一些友谊!

source: WARNING! YOU'RE ABOUT TO ACTIVATE A PLOTLINE!
target: 警告 警告 警告 警告 警告 警告 你就要开炮了!

source: For a PLOTLINE to appear, you first need to hoard enough of a RESOURCE.
target: 要想让PLTLINE出现 你首先需要囤积足够的资源

source: And they only appear if you've been on the road trip for enough WEEKS!
target: 只有在你旅行了足够多的周后才会出现!

source: First, a ROAD EVENT will simply let you decide if you want to engage with the PLOTLINE or not. Your choice!
target: 首先,一个ROAD EVERT 将只是让你决定 是否你想接触巴解宁。 你选吧!

source: If you choose to take on the PLOTLINE, you'll see three special ROAD EVENTS. Two are common EXCHANGE EVENTS, but the last one is... AN INCREMENTAL EVENT!
target: 如果你选择参加巴托尔式比赛,你会看到三个特殊的ROAD事件. 二是常见的外变事件,但后一是. 一场耐人寻味的盛会!

source: "What the fuck is that?" you may be asking. I'll tell you.
target: "什么他妈的是什么?" 你可能会问。 我告诉你。

source: An INCREMENTAL EVENT has THREE STAGES!
target: 一次耐人寻味的活动有三层楼!

source: In each STAGE, you'll face TWO OPTIONS.
target: 在每一个阶段,你将面临两个选择。

source: Here, each OPTION is tied to one of your RESOURCES.
target: 这里,每个选项 都与你的资源之一有关。

source: You must choose the OPTION tied to your highest RESOURCE of the two.
target: 你必须选择与你最高资源挂钩的选项

source: If you choose wrong, you'll fail, the INCREMENTAL EVENT will end, and the PLOTLINE will be cancelled.
target: 如果你选择错误,你就会失败, 内燃机事件将会结束, 并取消PLOTLINE。

source: If you succeed at the three STAGES, you'll unlock a new LAYER for the DESTINATION tied to the PLOTLINE.
target: 如果你在三个STAGES成功, 你会打开一个新的LAYER 为DESTINE捆绑。

source: But remember: you'll only see that awesome LAYER if you reach said DESTINATION!
target: 但记住,你只会看到 伟大的莱耶尔,如果你到达 说DESTING!

source: Godspeed!
target: 祝你们好运!

source: Hellooooo! Starting now, there will be more to the DESTINATIONS!
target: 哈罗! 从现在开始,会有更多的 DESTINATES!

source: Every DESTINATION has two extra LAYERS you can unlock!
target: 每块牌子都有两块牌子可以打开!

source: You can check all of the LAYER REQUIREMENTS in the DESTINATION guide whenever you want.
target: 随时可以检查DESTINTION指南中所有的LAYER要求.

source: (Touch the DESTINATION tab to the right or press the button shown in the tab.)
target: (按下鼠标标签右侧或按下标签中显示的按钮。)

source: (Press the button shown in the DESTINATION tab.)
target: (按下DESTINTION标签中显示的按钮. )

source: (Press the button shown in the DESTINATION tab.)
target: (按下DESTINTION标签中显示的按钮. )

source: (Click on the DESTINATION tab to the right, or press E on the keyboard or LB on the controller.)
target: (点击右侧的DESTINTION标签,或按键盘上E键或控制器上LB键.

source: You must fulfill the REQUIREMENTS of a LAYER and then reach its DESTINATION if you want to unlock it. It adds some cool extra stuff to the ending.
target: 你必须满足一个Layer的要求,然后到达它的断层,如果你想打开它。 给结尾添加了些很酷的额外东西

source: It's a bigger challenge with a bigger payoff!
target: 这是一个更大的挑战 与更大的回报!
